We've got the Saturday evening gala at the Orpheum, three-camera setup, festival archive reuse, sponsor product display on stage, and a general caption feed in the current draft. Before I sign off on the package, I need each of your final operating requirements. Could we go through technical, rights, talent, and accessibility in order? Who wants to start?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical requirement before we proceed. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms only — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue. The signed performance license I received this morning — which I have not yet entered into the rights tracker — permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive. We cannot approve the package as currently drafted with the archive reuse provision intact.
